title: 天平的使用与称量
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/164_天平的使用与称量.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/164_天平的使用与称量/src.py

points.K4: 药品不碰秤盘，选小容器
points.K10: 称液体：量体积或称量瓶

shots.scene: 欣欣站在带防风罩的分析天平旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside an analytical balance with a glass draft shield, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第二课：天平的使用与称量。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一张称量纸
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a square sheet of weighing paper and a small spatula.
shots.narration: 天平用得最多，方法对才称得准。

shots.scene: 阿杰抱着试剂瓶往秤盘上的纸上倒药品
shots.prompt_en: The young male student tilts a reagent bottle and pours powder onto weighing paper sitting on the balance pan, powder spilling on the pan.
shots.narration: 阿杰抱着试剂瓶，直接往秤上倒。

shots.scene: 粉末撒在天平里，读数乱跳
shots.prompt_en: Close view: powder scattered on the balance pan and floor of the draft shield, the side door open, a blank display flickering.
shots.narration: 药品撒进天平，读数还一直在跳。

shots.scene: 小研关上侧门，摇摇头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes the side door of the balance and shakes her head kindly, holding a clean spatula.
shots.narration: 小研说：称量有一套规矩。

shots.scene: 天平是实验室用得最多的仪器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a balance in the center surrounded by icons of a flask, a notebook and a powder bottle. No text.
shots.narration: 天平是化学实验室用得最多的仪器。

shots.scene: 质量与重量：在地球和月球上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the same block on Earth and on the Moon, the block size unchanged while a spring scale reading changes. No text.
shots.narration: 质量在哪儿都一样，重量随重力变。

shots.scene: 四类天平从粗到精
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four balances in a row from a triple-beam balance to a top-loading balance, an analytical balance and a microbalance, with growing magnifier icons. No text.
shots.narration: 三梁、顶载、分析、微量，越来越精。

shots.scene: 越精密越怕干扰
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a microbalance surrounded by small wind, vibration and temperature icons, and a price tag icon. No text.
shots.narration: 越精密越怕干扰，也越贵。

shots.scene: 重物放上分析天平，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a heavy bottle placed on a small analytical balance pan with a crack icon, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 重的东西上分析天平，会压坏它。

shots.scene: 少量样品放粗天平，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tiny pinch of powder on a coarse top-loading balance with a question mark, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 称少量的，粗天平又不够准。

shots.scene: 粗称用顶载，精称用分析天平
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an arrow from a large beaker to a top-loading balance and from a small vial to an analytical balance, both checked. No text.
shots.narration: 粗称用顶载天平，精确称量用分析天平。

shots.scene: 精度够用就好
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a balance chosen to match the needed precision, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 选天平，精度够用就好。

shots.scene: 【实拍】看天平的水平泡，旋转调平脚
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a finger points at the level bubble on an analytical balance, then hands turn a leveling foot until the bubble is centered.
shots.narration: 先看水平泡，气泡居中才算调平。

shots.scene: 开机预热
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a balance switched on with a clock icon beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 开机后按说明书预热，再开始称。

shots.scene: 检查秤盘有无灰尘残留
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a magnifier over a balance pan showing dust and powder grains. No text.
shots.narration: 看看秤盘和天平里干不干净。

shots.scene: 软毛刷扫净
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a soft brush sweeping powder off the balance pan into a small tray. No text.
shots.narration: 有灰有残留，用软毛刷扫干净。

shots.section_title: 药品不碰秤盘，选小容器
shots.scene: 药品直接放秤盘，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: powder poured directly onto a bare balance pan, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 药品绝不能直接碰秤盘。
overlay: 药品不碰秤盘，选小容器

shots.section_title: 药品不碰秤盘，选小容器
shots.scene: 称量纸、称量舟、反应瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: weighing paper, a small weighing boat and a small reaction flask side by side on a bench. No text.
shots.narration: 用称量纸、称量舟，或直接称进反应瓶。

shots.section_title: 药品不碰秤盘，选小容器
shots.scene: 容器越大越重，误差越大
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a large heavy dish beside a small light boat, a tiny pinch of powder sticking to the large dish surface. No text.
shots.narration: 选最小的容器，粘住带不走的少。

shots.section_title: 药品不碰秤盘，选小容器
shots.scene: 【实拍】称量纸沿对角线折一道
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands fold a square of weighing paper along one diagonal and open it slightly to form a channel.
shots.narration: 称量纸先沿对角线折一道，好倒。

shots.section_title: 药品不碰秤盘，选小容器
shots.scene: 超过最大称量，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a balance with an overload warning icon and a heavy object on it, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 看清最大称量，不能超载。

shots.scene: 【实拍】放上称量纸，关门，按去皮键
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: weighing paper placed in the center of the pan, the side door slid closed, a finger pressing the tare key, the display showing zero digits.
shots.narration: 放上容器，关门，去皮归零。

shots.scene: 试剂瓶和记录本带到天平旁
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student carrying a reaction flask and a notebook to the balance table. No text.
shots.narration: 把反应瓶和记录本带到天平旁。

shots.scene: 【实拍】把称量纸取出，在天平外用药匙少量加样
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the weighing paper lifted out of the balance, a clean spatula adding small amounts of white salt onto it outside the balance.
shots.narration: 取出容器，在外面用药匙少量多次加。

shots.scene: 抱瓶直接倒、在秤盘上舀，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bottle tipped over a balance and a spatula scooping inside the draft shield, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 别在秤盘上直接倒、直接舀。

shots.scene: 放回关门再读
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the paper returned to the balance pan center, the door closed, an eye icon on the blank display. No text.
shots.narration: 放回去关门读数，少了再取出来加。

shots.scene: 多取的放进废物容器，倒回原瓶打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: extra powder going into a labeled waste container with a check mark, powder going back into the stock bottle crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 多了放进废物容器，绝不倒回原瓶。

shots.scene: 【实拍】关门等读数不跳再记录
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the balance door closed, a hand waiting with a pen over a notebook while the display digits settle.
shots.narration: 关门等几秒，读数稳了再记录。

shots.scene: 取下重称，三次平均
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the same object weighed three times with three reading icons merging into one average. No text.
shots.narration: 称物体可取下重称，三次取平均。

shots.scene: 倒入反应瓶后再称空纸
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: powder poured from folded paper into a flask, then the empty paper weighed again, a minus sign between two readings. No text.
shots.narration: 倒进反应瓶，再称空纸，差值是用量。

shots.scene: 称好立即加入，托纸穿过人群打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: weighed powder added to the flask right at the balance with a check mark, a student carrying weighing paper through a crowded lab crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 称好就地加进瓶里，别托着纸乱走。

shots.scene: 侧门开着，风吹动秤盘
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an open balance side door with air flow arrows pushing on the pan, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 侧门一直关着，风会吹动秤盘。

shots.scene: 倚靠天平台，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student leaning on the balance table with an arm on it, vibration lines, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 别倚靠天平台，也别把手搭上去。

shots.scene: 戴手套拿容器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gloved hand holding a vial, a bare fingerprint on another vial with a plus sign. No text.
shots.narration: 戴手套拿容器，手上油脂会增重。

shots.scene: 外壁擦干，放在秤盘中央
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a vial wiped dry with a tissue, then placed in the exact center of the pan. No text.
shots.narration: 容器外壁擦干，放在秤盘正中。

shots.scene: 对着样品哈气，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: breath vapor drifting onto an open sample on the pan, crossed out, a wet sample icon with a drying arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 样品要干，别对着它呼气。

shots.scene: 恒温、少用塑料、防静电
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thermometer icon steady, a plastic container with static spark icons crossed out, a glass container checked. No text.
shots.narration: 室温恒定，少用塑料容器防静电。

shots.scene: 热的坩埚放进干燥器冷却
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: tongs placing a hot crucible into a desiccator to cool. No text.
shots.narration: 热的东西放进干燥器冷却，防吸湿。

shots.scene: 热物体在秤盘上搅起气流
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a warm object on the pan with rising air currents and an unstable reading icon, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 冷热物体搅动气流，回到室温再称。

shots.scene: 取出后间隔相同时间再称
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dried sample taken from a desiccator, a clock showing the same interval before each weighing. No text.
shots.narration: 超干的东西会吸湿，每次隔相同时间称。

shots.scene: 取下物品读数应回零
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an empty balance pan with a display returning to zero, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 取下物品，读数应该回到零。

shots.scene: 回不到零，重新去皮重称
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an empty pan with a display not at zero, an arrow to tare and weigh again. No text.
shots.narration: 回不到零，零点偏了，要重称。

shots.scene: 空载读数也在变：漂移
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an empty balance with a wavy line graph rising slowly, a warning mark. No text.
shots.narration: 空载读数也在慢慢变，就是漂移。

shots.scene: 排查四个原因
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons: an open door, an evaporating sample, a warm sample and a static spark. No text.
shots.narration: 门没关？蒸发吸湿？没到室温？静电？

shots.section_title: 称液体：量体积或称量瓶
shots.scene: 量体积，用密度换算质量
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pipette measuring a liquid volume, an arrow with a density icon to a mass icon. No text.
shots.narration: 称液体，多是量体积再用密度换算。
overlay: 称液体：量体积或称量瓶

shots.section_title: 称液体：量体积或称量瓶
shots.scene: 粘稠液体直接称
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thick viscous liquid dripping slowly into a vial on a balance. No text.
shots.narration: 粘稠的量不准，就直接称。

shots.section_title: 称液体：量体积或称量瓶
shots.scene: 【实拍】易挥发液体用带盖称量瓶
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a gloved hand places a small glass weighing bottle with its ground glass lid closed onto the balance pan.
shots.narration: 易挥发的液体，用带盖称量瓶。

shots.scene: 天平会变得不准
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a balance with a question mark over its display. No text.
shots.narration: 天平用久了，也会变得不准。

shots.scene: 【实拍】用镊子夹标准砝码放上秤盘
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: tweezers lift a small metal calibration weight from its case and place it in the center of the pan.
shots.narration: 用镊子夹标准砝码，不用手拿。

shots.scene: 量程两头各称一次，偏差报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small weight and a large weight each on the balance, a deviation icon with an arrow to a teacher icon. No text.
shots.narration: 量程两头各称一次，偏差大就报告。

shots.scene: 撒在天平里，先弄清是什么
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: spilled powder in the balance with a magnifier over a bottle label. No text.
shots.narration: 撒了要马上清，先弄清撒的是什么。

shots.scene: 用嘴吹，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person blowing powder off a balance pan with a dust cloud, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 千万别用嘴吹，会吸进去、扬一屋子。

shots.scene: 【实拍】先取出样品，再用软毛刷扫净秤盘
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the sample container taken out first, then a soft brush sweeping white salt grains off the pan into a small tray.
shots.narration: 先取出样品，再用软刷扫净天平。

shots.scene: 湿纸巾擦净，按化学废物收集
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a damp wipe cleaning the bench, the wipe placed into a labeled chemical waste container. No text.
shots.narration: 湿纸巾擦净，清理物按化学废物收集。

shots.scene: 称有毒粉末用称量罩或通风柜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a balance inside a ventilated weighing enclosure, a student wearing goggles, gloves and a lab coat. No text.
shots.narration: 称有毒粉末，在称量罩或通风柜里。

shots.scene: 有毒粉末干扫，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dry brush sweeping toxic powder with a dust cloud rising, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 撒了有毒粉末，别用刷子干扫。

shots.scene: 湿巾轻擦，按危险废物收集
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a damp wipe gently laid over powder, then placed into a hazardous waste bag. No text.
shots.narration: 湿巾轻轻擦，按危险废物收集。

shots.scene: 查SDS，报告老师
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a safety data sheet with an arrow to a teacher icon, a lock icon for controlled chemicals. No text.
shots.narration: 先查说明书，有毒的报告老师。

shots.scene: 扫净固体，擦干液体
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a soft brush and a dry wipe cleaning the balance and bench after use. No text.
shots.narration: 用完扫净固体，擦干液体。

shots.scene: 关门防灰，带走自己的东西
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: balance doors closed, a student taking away his flask, spatula and notebook. No text.
shots.narration: 关好门防灰，带走自己的东西。

shots.scene: 天平比来时更整洁
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a spotless balance table with a check mark and a smiling clean balance icon. No text.
shots.narration: 让天平比你来时更整洁。

shots.scene: 重的粗天平、轻的分析天平
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a heavy beaker to a top-loading balance, a small vial to an analytical balance. No text.
shots.narration: 按量选天平，调平、预热、去皮。

shots.scene: 取下加样、关门读数
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a spatula adding powder outside the balance, a closed door and a steady reading icon. No text.
shots.narration: 药品不碰秤盘，取下加样关门读。

shots.scene: 不倒回、撒了就清
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a waste container with a check mark, a stock bottle crossed out, a brush cleaning the pan. No text.
shots.narration: 多了不倒回，撒了就清，用完整洁。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着移液管和容量瓶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a volumetric pipette and a volumetric flask and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：容量仪器与移液器。
